verdict.rationale: The DGX B200 documents its own non-GUI control surfaces: command-line health checks, Redfish/IPMI/SNMP remote management, node-wide GPU administration software, and a bundled Docker Engine with the NVIDIA Container Toolkit for scripted workloads. However, no evidence explicitly documents headless or CI-pipeline automation workflows for the system; the JAX public CI is NVIDIA's own CI, not a user capability. missing for 10: explicit headless/CI automation documentation for DGX B200, documented scriptable job submission or automation APIs beyond management protocols, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: It also provides simple commands for checking the health of the DGX B200 system from the command line.
Supports Redfish, IPMI, SNMP, KVM, and Web user interface
This software enables node-wide administration of GPUs and can be used for cluster and data-center level management.
